deliveryCheck.text:
Hello {{name}},

This is a test email from CrewPoint, sent to check that email reaches you and your {{word.group.one.lower}}. You don't need to do anything.

CrewPoint

signInLink.subject: Your CrewPoint sign-in link
signInLink.text:
Hello,

Tap this link to sign in to CrewPoint and carry on where you left off:

{{link}}

The link works once and expires in an hour. If you didn't ask for it, you can ignore this email; nobody can sign in without it.

CrewPoint
signInLink.push: Your CrewPoint sign-in link is in your email.
